_comment: Success areas of the simulated tasks (section 5.1.1): the part of the last leg within d of the goal surface. Coordinates come from the world files (pilot/success.py reads the named solids, which are axis-aligned boxes); the last leg runs north in both worlds. A run succeeds if it ended with rest, the robot was upright at that moment, and the torso, projected on the floor, was in the area.

upright._comment: Upright = the torso's up axis is within this angle of vertical at the moment the bridge receives rest. A standing or crouching NAO is within a few degrees; a fallen one is near 90.
